notes.title: 🛠️ Chamber X - Full Release Update (June 2025)
notes.notes:
Hey survivors,



A fresh update is now live for Chamber X! We’ve listened to your feedback and made several improvements to the full game. Here’s what’s new:



Update Highlights:

Revamped the UI and main menu for a better user experience,

Collision fixes in select hidden rooms for smoother navigation,

Item visuals updated for more immersive environments,

Increased range when interacting with notes and documents,

Reduced number of monsters to one — redesigned with a new look and texture,

Adjusted item locations to improve pacing and discovery,

Improved visibility of the first key to help new players get started,



Thank you for playing and supporting Chamber X. More updates and content are on the way — stay tuned!

 Share your feedback with us — every comment helps improve the game!

 Play Chamber X on Steam
